rationale: With only 9 minutes to close, the stock is sitting at 91.6% of its daily range near the session high after a strong gap-up day, but the last 5 candles show a clear deceleration and mild drift lower (from ~119.40 to 119.23), suggesting momentum is fading rather than continuing. The spread and liquidity are acceptable, but the risk/reward of entering either direction this close to forced liquidation — with ATR of only $0.27 and price already compressing — does not justify committing capital when any adverse tick could trigger the stop before a meaningful move develops.
